title: Explicit bridge between finite cochain and canonical tensor models
statement:
For sites X,Y with their recorded derived tensor models and a ringed pullback f with its normalized ordinary comparison k, retain k.q and k.mu to construct the legacy ordinary comparison. Its total inverse is the cochain comparison. Independent coefficient K-flatness with site-flat terms is equivalent to the native flat-term K-flat predicate, so restriction defines a native tensor model with the same components. The ordinary normalized module unit j gives the same single-complex map as CochainPullback.unit. The cochain comparison recovered from a homotopy comparison has its original components. In particular:
theorem unit_presentation {X Y : Site.{u, w}}
    (f : RingedPullback.{u, u, u, u, u} Y.A X.A) (k : Comparison f) :
    ∃ j : f.L.obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ring) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ring,
      (∀ M : Y.modules,
        ((legacyComparison f k).mu M (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ring)).hom ≫
            (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.A).tensorHom (𝟙 _) j.hom ≫
            ((SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.A).rightUnitor (f.L.obj M)).hom =
          f.L.map ((SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.A).rightUnitor M).hom) ∧
      (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex f.L (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ring) ≫
        (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.modules 0).map j.hom = (unit f k).hom

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0G7E, the canonical tensor comparison on flat-term K-flat representatives; ordinary unit compatibility uses Modules on Sites, Tag 03EL.

proof.text: Define the legacy ordinary comparison field by field from k. Both total comparisons use tensorPullbackTotal with the same tensor isomorphisms, so their inverse maps agree by congruence. The homotopy-to-complex quotient isomorphisms have identity components; their functor images are identities, and the recovered counit component simplifies to the original one.

Independent coefficient K-flatness is the existing native K-flat predicate. Transport exactness of right tensoring along siteSheafTensorRightIso and its inverse to identify the term-flatness predicates. Restrict X.model.comparison along the full subcategory inclusion to construct canonical_model; its component equation is definitional.

Use the module unit fixed by the ordinary normalized comparison. Its right unit equation is the specification of canonicalRingedTensorComparison_unit. The chosen cochain unit is defined by the single-map comparison followed by the single-complex image of precisely that module unit, giving the final equation by reflexivity.
